shortDescription: TOKYO, Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CTW NASDAQ:CTW (“CTW” or “the Company”), a leading game platform company providing global access to web-based games through its flagship platform, G123.jp, today announced that its Chief Financial Officer Patrick Liu will participate in a virtual fireside c…

children: (“CTW” or “the Company”), a leading game platform company providing global access to web-based games through its flagship platform, G123.jp, today announced that its Chief Financial Officer Patrick Liu will participate in a virtual fireside chat hosted by Aaron Grey, CFA, CPA, Managing Director and Head of Consumer Research at Alliance Global Partners (A.G.P.), on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
Aaron Grey, CFA, CPA, Managing Director and Head of Consumer Research, A.G.P.

“We appreciate A.G.P. providing this opportunity to engage with investors and discuss CTW’s business and growth strategy,” said Patrick Liu, Chief Financial Officer of CTW. “We look forward to discussing the G123.jp platform, our approach to officially licensed anime IP, the economics of our browser-based gaming model, and our efforts to expand our presence in the United States.”
A replay of the fireside chat will be available following the event on the Investors page of the Company’s website at
Institutional investors interested in attending or arranging a follow-up meeting with CTW management may contact their A.G.P. representative or CTW Investor Relations at investor@ctw.inc.
CTW is a leading game platform company providing global access to web-based, free-to-play games inspired by popular Japanese anime IP, including
So I’m a Spider, So What? Ruler of the Labyrinth
Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest – Rebellion Soul

. CTW delivers these games through its globally accessible flagship platform, G123.jp, which has accumulated paying users in over 180 countries since its 2018 launch. Founded in Tokyo in 2013, CTW partners with anime and manga IP holders to bring officially licensed titles to players around the world with no downloads or account registration required.
For more information, visit www.ctw.inc or G123.jp.
